Bug_Details:
Futures.getChecked requires a checked exception type with a standard constructor. The passed exception type must not be a RuntimeException, and it must expose a
public constructor whose only parameters are of type String or Throwable.
getChecked will reject any other type with an IllegalArgumentException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is intentionally embedded by using an unchecked exception (CustomUncheckedException) with Futures.getChecked, which expects a checked exception. However, since Futures.getChecked cannot be used due to missing dependencies, the code throws the exception directly to simulate the bug.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the FuturesGetCheckedExample class, which intentionally uses an unchecked exception, causing an IllegalArgumentException.
